Description
American icons—both natural and cultural— mirror the diverse stories that define the American experience. This new ‘Reflections of America’ series begins with a cowboy in the Yellowstone area of the Western United States and symbolizes a rugged ideal of independence, frontier spirit, and a deep connection to the land. Celebrate the American West with this beautiful 1oz pure gold bar minted by MKS PAMP in Switzerland! This bar is individually serialized and housed in a CertiPAMP™ assay card.
PAMP Suisse, a prominent Swiss refinery was founded in Ticino in 1977. It quickly rose to prominence due to its outstanding craftsmanship. Investors and Collectors around the glove love the PAMP bullion brand. It Produces high-quality bullion bars and uses the most recent technologies to prevent bullion counterfeiting,
The 1 oz PAMP Suisse Gold bar contains 1 troy oz of gold of purity .9999 and comes with its original tamper-evident assay card which authenticates the weight and purity of the gold. The weight and purity of these gold bars are backed by the PAMP Suisse.
The assaying services of the bullion brand PAMP Suisse are world-famous likewise, it is among the world’s premier private mints which are manufacturing such amazing gold bars and ingots. This is why the gold investors and collectors have trust in precious metal items such as
gold
and silver from PAMP Suisse
Design of
1 oz PAMP Suisse Reflections of America Yellowstone Cowboy (In Assay)
The obverse of the
Reflections of America – Yellowstone
gold bar features a classic scene inspired by the American West. At the center of the design is a
cowboy seated on horseback
, overlooking the rugged wilderness associated with Yellowstone and the surrounding frontier landscape.
The rider and horse are depicted in fine detail, capturing the spirit of exploration and the heritage of the American frontier. Beneath the scene is the series’ signature
reflection effect
, where the image appears mirrored below, as though reflected on calm water. This artistic feature is a hallmark of PAMP’s
Reflections of America
series and creates a visually striking symmetry in the design.
The reverse side displays the traditional
PAMP Suisse bullion markings
in a clean, vertical layout. These inscriptions typically include:
PAMP SUISSE
(the refinery’s hallmark)
1 OZ
(weight)
FINE GOLD
999.9
(four-nines purity)
A
unique serial number
is also stamped onto the bar, confirming its authenticity and traceability. The reverse design is intentionally simple and official in appearance, emphasizing the bar’s status as both a trusted
investment-grade bullion product
and a beautifully crafted collectible piece.
Main Highlights of
1 oz PAMP Suisse Reflections of America Yellowstone Cowboy (In Assay)
Contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold.
Weight and Purity backed by the PAMP Suisse.
Mint uses a thin, plastic sheeting to protect your assay card when it is shipped.
Eligible to Precious Metal IRAs.
Features its own unique serial number
